notes: SD uploads: interrupted uploads can now be resumed from where they stopped (device reports incomplete files), recorder playback pauses during transfers, and chunks are retry-safe. SD browser shows real WAV durations for any sample rate/bit depth. SCM: new Amp Gate input on the Audio Output strip keeps the speaker amp on during quiet passages. Breakout pots bound to CCs work again, and MIDI-strip pot cables support a Min/Max range. Also: untouched patcher faders no longer override module settings; AudioRecorder Autoplay and Loop fixes. Includes all changes since 1.10.70.
